intended_behavior: Rename VehicleTelemetry.vehicle_id to asset_id at wire field 1, retaining string type and all wire values. The external producer request key remains vehicle_id; write its exact value into asset_id. Consumer observations use asset_id instead of vehicle_id; preserve empty, Unicode, whitespace and escaped identifiers without trimming or normalization. Keep float32 speed_mps, expose the decoded float32 value as a JSON number; any decimal form that rounds to that float32 is accepted, and keep strict speeding >30.0. Producer input and incoming payload are independent. No json_name option is introduced. Other domains and tests are unchanged. NaN, infinity, out-of-float32-range inputs and signed-zero bit distinctions are outside this case.
